description: Request Review history page (GET /api/students/change-requests/history), N=3 distinct children, each with one decided (rejected) request of every kind and one direct offering correction, measured inside a tenant transaction (BEGIN and scope included, trailing COMMIT excluded). Each of the five sources reads its rows and their children, names and reviewers by ID set; the submitter names follow. Equal at N=3 and N=8: the offering queue's requested-offering names load in one catalog read for the page (#7808; before, one catalog read per row without a decision snapshot).
